crossRefs.note: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes.
I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.
Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.
Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your loving kindness.
Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.
My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.
but his delight is in Yahweh’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.
These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart;
It shall be with him, and he shall read from it all the days of his life, that he may learn to fear Yahweh his God, to…
This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, that you may observe…
For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.

translations.web: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.
translations.bsb: Oh, how I love Your law! All day long it is my meditation.
translations.kjv: MEM. O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.
translations.asv: Oh how love I thy law! It is my meditation all the day.
